subject: Zenith Health onboarding — PO token assignment and spend-bucket questions
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenithhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO & spend caps for Redwood

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking us through the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to get the PO set up so we can start provisioning dedicated capacity and finalize the initial billing. Can you confirm the following:

- How your PO numbering will appear on invoices (we need a format that maps to our ledger)
- The spend cap options for the first 90 days while we validate usage
- Any vendor onboarding forms you need from us (W9, bank remittance, security addendum)

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (zenith_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). Our preferred billing contact is accounts-payable@zenithhealth.com but I can loop in an AP person if required.

Also, please let me know if you need a provisional PO while finance runs routing. We aim to have a signed contract by next Friday.

Best,
Amit Shah
Procurement Manager
Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO & spend caps for Redwood

Hi Amit —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the onboarding form. A few notes and next steps from our side so procurement/finance can move quickly:

1) Provisional PO token: we can issue a provisional PO token to unblock provisioning while final PO paperwork completes. Provisional token (non-invoiceable): PO-2027-ZN-0047-PROV.

2) Standard invoice PO format: PO-YYYY-ACCT-#### (we'll map PO-2027-ZN-0047 to your Zenith ledger code once you confirm).

3) Spend caps: typical pilot window options are $75k / $125k / $150k for 90 days. We usually recommend starting with $125k for a medium-scale pilot; happy to adjust per your risk appetite.

4) Attachments: I’m attaching our procurement checklist (redwood-procurement-checklist.xlsx). Please return the completed form and W9 to Monica (cc'd).

Next actions:
- Monica will attempt to issue the final PO number after finance review.
- Amit: if you can confirm AP contact and preferred spend cap, we’ll lock routing and line items.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-procurement-checklist.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO & spend caps for Redwood

Jordan / Amit —

Finance completed a preliminary review of the onboarding packet you submitted. We can issue a formal PO; I am attaching the generated PO PDF for your records: PO-2027-ZN-0047. A few important items to note before we finalize routing to your ledger:

- Final PO number (invoiceable): PO-2027-ZN-0047. Please reference this on all invoices.
- Spend cap: after a quick risk review we adjusted the initial spend cap to $125,000 for the 90-day pilot (was requested $150k). If Zenith needs the higher cap we can escalate to FP&A but that will add ~3 business days.
- Line item correction: SKU RW-API-1 in your draft maps to two distinct billable flows in our system. We are splitting it into RW-API-1A (Core API calls) and RW-API-1B (Embeddings pilot). Please confirm the unit descriptions so our AP coding matches your product taxonomy.

Requested from Zenith: completed W9 and bank remit form (for ACH). We can't issue invoiceable credit until we have those.

Next steps: I attached the official PO PDF (po_PO-2027-ZN-0047.pdf) — once Amit confirms the SKU split wording and returns W9, we will remove the PROV token and activate the invoiceable PO.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

Attachment: po_PO-2027-ZN-0047.pdf

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenithhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@zenithhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-08T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO & spend caps for Redwood

Monica / Jordan —

Thanks for the PO PDF. I reviewed the line item note and attached our internal catalog (zenith_internal_catalog.csv) so you can see how we map SKUs. Two quick clarifications:

1) SKU split: we saw RW-API-1 -> RW-API-1A / 1B. That is fine, but provisioning works off our catalog codes (Z-CORE-001 and Z-EMB-002). Can Redwood align the PO line items to those catalog codes so our provisioning queue doesn’t choke?

2) Spend-bucket application: please confirm whether the $125k cap is applied to the account-level total or per-line-item. We should route $90k for Core and $35k for Embeddings if possible.

I have uploaded the W9 to the link you provided (see attachment). If you need anything else from AP, let me know.

Thanks,
Amit
Procurement Manager
Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith_internal_catalog.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenithhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO & spend caps for Redwood

Quick operational note so we can close this out today:

- Mapping guidance: Monica, please set the invoice line descriptions like this so Zenith's provisioning maps cleanly:
  * RW-API-1A — Core API usage (map to Z-CORE-001)
  * RW-API-1B — Embeddings pilot (map to Z-EMB-002)

- Spend allocation: allocate $90,000 of the $125,000 to RW-API-1A (Core) and $35,000 to RW-API-1B (Embeddings). That preserves the finance-approved cap while aligning to Amit's request.

- Activation steps: once W9 is confirmed and Monica toggles PROV -> invoiceable in the billing portal, AP can accept invoices against PO-2027-ZN-0047.

I attached a brief note for our billing team with the exact split instructions (lineitem-split-instructions.md) and pushed an internal ticket to the provisioning queue. Monica, please update the PO PDF to include the two line items and the Z-* mapping before I close the ticket.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: lineitem-split-instructions.md
